scope: Steam English retail FastFile catalog, source-available subset only
proofBoundary: Every one of the 215 currently source-available English-retail FastFile paths has a per-zone native XModel identity report and every per-zone population gate is closed.

All 21693 source-consuming XModel occurrences independently match the pinned native loader source endpoint and close identity through either exact inline XString equality or a structurally proven packed XString pointer plus the pinned native resolved XModel object name.
Exactly 19905 source-consuming rows close through inline names and 1788 close through packed-name native identity; packed-name rows are not treated as source-byte strings.

All 562 zero-source top-level XModel references resolve through the pinned native loader to non-null XModel object identities without source-byte scanning, adjacency inference, mesh similarity, or visual matching.
The 22255 count is a per-zone occurrence population, not a globally deduplicated unique-XModel count; repeated model names or payloads across zones remain separate occurrences here.

The 82 source-unavailable catalog paths and six multi-depot byte-identity cases remain explicit blockers, so this checkpoint does not claim complete English-retail XModel population or historical depot-byte closure.
Character classification, XAnim semantic pairing, Material/TechniqueSet/shader reconstruction, texture recovery, and export-format fidelity remain independent downstream gates.
